decisions.reason: This glass flake spraying system builds directly on the firm’s established spraying know-how and, with continued website presence in 2023 and 2024, fits a high-absorptive-capacity area where the firm can refine and commercialize it efficiently.

The low-pressure injection pump is very close to the core business, has dedicated market presentation in both years, and the documented field-test learning suggests the firm can use its R&D and application knowledge to improve and scale it.

Because this transfer pump reuses proven WIWA air motors and extends an existing product family, it is strongly related to the firm’s prior knowledge base and should be retained as a low-risk exploitation of existing capabilities.

Fire protection flow monitoring remains prominently presented and supports the firm’s strategic move toward more digitalized and interoperable customer systems, an area where its engineering base and research links can help it learn quickly.

This hydraulic two-component spraying system is a very recent launch that is close to the established offer, so absorptive-capacity logic favors giving it more time because the firm already has the technical base and R&D capability to improve it.
